instruction: Serve the static site in /var/www/site, returning 404 for missing files instead of redirecting or proxying.
Configure a React single-page app so any unknown client-side route falls back to /index.html.
Configure a Vue application with history-mode routing so unknown paths under /app fall back to /app/index.html.
Cache fingerprinted bundles under /assets for one year with an immutable Cache-Control header.
Serve images from /images with a 7 day browser cache.
Prevent browsers from mangling binaries such as zip, gz and exe downloads by disabling charset processing for them.
Enable human-readable directory listing for /pub/ftp/ with local timestamps.
Keep directory listing disabled everywhere on files.example.com while still serving files from /var/www/files.
Serve favicon.ico and robots.txt from /var/www/seo without writing access log entries for them.
Enable progressive MP4 playback from /videos using the mp4 module with a 1 MB start buffer.
Force the browser to download the report file /dl/latest-report.csv by sending a Content-Disposition attachment header with an explicit filename.
Block access to dotfiles such as .git and .env everywhere while still allowing ACME challenges under /.well-known/acme-challenge/.
Use a named location fallback so any missing file on brand.example.com returns a branded 404 page.
Serve the admin SPA under /admin with a fallback to its own index.html for client-side routes.
Register correct content types for WebAssembly and ES module files served from the /modules/ directory.
Serve large video files from /media/ using sendfile, thread-based aio and directio to keep big files out of the page cache.
Show a custom 404 page on the legacy documentation site without breaking requests for missing subdirectory paths.
Expose /data/ as a downloadable file repository with directory listing enabled and charset utf-8.
Deny access to backup and database files with the extensions .bak, .conf, .sql, .old and .orig anywhere under the web root.
Apply the classic deploy caching policy: never cache the HTML shell but cache everything under /static/ forever.
